description: Wastewater Systems Effluent Regulations Reported Data is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. The Wastewater Systems Effluent Regulations (WSER), developed under the Fisheries Act, came into force in 2012 to manage wastewater releases by systems that collect an average daily influent volume of 100 cubic metres or more. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. Its tags are Waste water, Regulations, Statutory Instrument, wastewater, water. It offers 20 resource(s) in CSV, DOCX, HTML, TXT, XLS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
